title: Anchor opt-in registry
description: Anchors that have intentionally opted in to public compliance validation. An anchor absent from this file is never crawled or published. See registry/README.md.

domain.description: Anchor home domain, exactly as it would be passed to the validator: lowercase, no scheme, no port, no path, no trailing dot. This is the key of the entry; duplicates are rejected in CI.

name.description: Human-readable anchor name, shown in the dashboard directory.

network.description: Network the anchor is validated against. An anchor serving both registers one entry per network.

enabled.description: Whether the anchor is currently validated. Set to false to opt out: the entry is retained for audit, and the crawler excludes it.

contact.description: Email address for the operator, used only to reach them about their own results.

addedAt.description: When the entry was first added, as an ISO 8601 instant in UTC (e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z). Not updated on later edits.
